newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-April aluminium exports up 80.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-April aluminium exports up 80.1 pct.

text.p: China's exports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials reached 78,480 tonnes in January-April 1997, up 80.1 percent compared with the year-ago period, customs figures showed on Tuesday.
Exports in April alone were 22,347 tonnes.

China's exports of unwrought aluminium, including alloys, rose by a year-on-year 77.5 percent in the first four months to 54,137 tonnes, the figures showed. Exports for April alone were 14,878 tonnes.
China's imports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials reached 188,241 tonnes in the first four months, up 0.4 percent compared with the year-ago period, the figures showed.
Imports for April alone were 58,516 tonnes.
Imports of unwrought aluminium, including alloys, were 102,436 tonnes in the first four months, a drop of 13.8 percent compared with the same period in 1996, the figures showed.
Imports for April alone were 29,547 tonnes.
